cases.rationale: A real hydrant has a domed bolted cap, cylindrical body and side outlets. Beside it is a fixed metal drinking-fountain basin with a drain and plumbing/spout context, supporting sink rather than a portable bowl. The surrounding grass and paving contain no identifiable additional category objects. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A person is riding a narrow white surfboard on a breaking wave. The board's deck and pointed end in active surfing context distinguish it from a boat, snowboard or skateboard. The remaining crop is water and spray. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

The entire crop is a tiled graphic/photo collage with grid boundaries, text and pictures. The depicted people, sports equipment, vegetables and plants are images within that collage, not actual category objects in a photographed scene. No physical book or display enclosing the collage is identifiable. All 75 definitions were considered under the depiction exclusion; no unresolved category ambiguity.

Several actual people are visible in the indoor scene. The small brown bread-like item held over a white napkin could be a sandwich, but filling is not resolved, so sandwich (48) remains unclear. Partly occluded furniture at the lower/right edge does not clearly establish a single-person chair or dining tabletop, leaving chair (56) and dining table (60) unclear. Clothing graphics are excluded as actual animals; the held white material is a napkin rather than an identifiable bowl or cup. All 75 definitions were considered; no other unresolved category ambiguity.

The kitchen contains an open laptop with visible integrated keyboard, a microwave with a dark front door at left, and a sink basin with faucet. Several living plants sit in distinct pots along the window ledge, and a clear narrow-neck capped bottle stands at the right. The laptop screen is not a standalone TV; the left appliance is a kettle rather than a cup or bottle. The surface is a kitchen counter rather than a dining table, and lower panels do not establish an oven or refrigerator. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A green spoon and yellow tined fork lie beside several open food bowls and a recognizable handleless drinking glass. The upper-right basket contains broccoli florets and orange carrot pieces. Other vegetables include cucumber/celery and tomatoes rather than identifiable apples or oranges. The patterned support does not establish a dining table rather than another food-preparation surface. The round vessels are bowls, not stemmed wine glasses. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

Multiple actual scissors hang from a wall rack; their paired metal blades and finger loops are clearly visible. The chickens/roosters and landscape above them are painted decorations and do not count as actual birds or other animals. Scissor blades do not count as separate knives. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A red-and-yellow toothbrush lies horizontally against a tiled background, with its narrow handle and upright bristle head plainly visible. The yellow molded grip decoration is not an actual animal or food item. No sink or other fixture is visible merely because bathroom tiles are present. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A child holds a pink hair dryer, with a white sink basin visible behind her at the upper left. The dryer is not a bottle, phone or remote. A small red shallow vessel on the rear counter could be a bowl or a flat dish/tray; its depth is insufficiently clear, so bowl (45) remains unclear. The patterned dark fabric does not establish a bag or furniture item, and the counter is not a dining table. All 75 definitions were considered; no other unresolved category ambiguity.

A severely high-contrast mountain scene contains a small partly clipped group of quadrupeds at the lower left. Their bodies and legs are visible, but the thresholded detail does not resolve horse versus sheep versus cattle identity, so horse (17), sheep (18) and cow (19) remain unclear rather than asserting a species. The marks do not establish an identifiable rider or person, and the mountain and snow are not objects in the remaining categories. All 75 definitions were considered; no other unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual person lies across a large gray sculpted bear. The bear has a rigid molded/stone surface and is a statue, while the bears behind it are painted on the fence; neither counts as an actual bear or a plush teddy bear. Snow, rocks and unpotted vegetation contain no other identifiable category objects. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A person stands on grass holding a blue flying disc in a throwing posture. The disc's shallow rim and use context identify a frisbee rather than a plate, bowl or wheel. The background consists of grass, bare ground and shadows, with no identifiable further category objects. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.
